name: Still Canon

type-system.twistDescription: Heading weights shifted 300→500, heading line-heights loosened ~1.15x→1.25x; sohne-var replaced with DM Sans (Google Fonts)

motion-system.twistDescription: All durations scaled 1.5x; ease-in-out replaced with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for material deceleration

grid-system.twistDescription: Column count reduced 12→10, column width expanded to 93.6px, gap increased 20% to 36px

spacing-system.twistDescription: All spacing values scaled 1.2x for more generous editorial whitespace

interaction-states.twistDescription: Explicit 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) on all elements; scale(1.02) hover on buttons and nav links

nav-system.twistDescription: Position changed static→fixed; border-bottom added on scroll

concept-summary.twistDescription: Design Principles paragraph shifted to material/object-oriented register; concept_by_video.md generated

checkA.notes: navText #000000 vs transparent background — adequate contrast on all three required pairs

checkB.notes: hover transitions 0.35s vs motion base 0.3s — within 5x threshold

checkC.notes: nav fontFamily 'Simply-ChocolateCOMPBold' (proprietary) replaced with 'inherit' — picks up DM Sans from assembled type-system

namingRationale: 'Still' captures the motion philosophy — languid, no springs, deceleration only. 'Canon' captures editorial authority, rule-bound precision, and the legal register of the intended application context.
